description:
We are a team of curious, creative, and passionate people who are interested in space, science, and technology. Our goal is to explore new ideas, solve real-world problems, and develop innovative solutions using science, teamwork, and creativity.

We believe that great ideas come from collaboration. We are excited to learn from others, share our knowledge, and turn our ideas into meaningful projects.
summary:
We made an interactive website that tells the story of the rovers NASA has left on the Moon and Mars: the Apollo 15, 16 and 17 Lunar Roving Vehicles, and the Perseverance, Curiosity and Sojourner rovers.
Visitors point at a rover to see it appear in a Moon or Mars scene. Clicking it opens a short, kid-friendly story with key facts such as place, mission and distance driven. A Map page shows exactly where each rover stopped, using a photo map of the Moon’s near side and a flat map of Mars, with coordinates for every rover. A References page credits every source.
The project answers the challenge by turning scattered mission data into a clear, visual story that school-age space fans can explore on their own. It matters because these machines are still out there, and many young people have never heard of them. Seeing where they sit makes space exploration feel real and inspires the next generation of explorers.
details: Our project is an interactive Virtual Space Museum designed to introduce school-age space enthusiasts to NASA’s historic hardware across the solar system. Instead of placing exhibits inside traditional museum rooms, the entire experience takes place on one page by clicking on the rover that the user is interested in and easily getting the important information. We as a team want to make it easier for people to get the information they want by just clicking one button on one page instead of having to go through multiple pages to reach what they want. We got help from chatbots such as Cloud while making the website to provide more of our limited time on creativity and research. Our project is distinct from traditional websites as instead of clicking to another page or scrolling down to get more information you can learn everything that is offered by the website by just clicking. This website is especially intended for kids under the age of 10 so while designing the website we wanted to give the information as simply as possible and make the information easy to reach even for someone that has never used a website. Cloud has also been used to add the subtitles in the demo.
